en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a large medieval stone wall and tower covered partly with vegetation on the left, clearly a ruin with tall arched windows. On the right side are multi‑story town buildings with shops and signs, and further back a church or town‑hall tower rises above the rooftops. People are walking along the cobbled street. Printed German captions at the top read "Großenhain i. Sa." and "Ruine." Additional commercial signage is visible on the buildings.
